Container.Name: artcraft-all-apps
Container.Overview: Unofficial x86-64 container with all 17 ArtCraft creative apps in one browser desktop.
Container.Description: Based on LinuxServer.io's Craft Apps and Selkies. Open the HTTPS desktop on port 3001 and accept its self-signed certificate. The desktop includes a terminal; keep it on a trusted local network unless you provide strong external authentication. This image is not maintained by LinuxServer.io or the ArtCraft team.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ArtCraft PhotoCraft VectorCraft FilmCraft LightCraft PdfCraft EffectCraft AniCraft DesignCraft FigCraft TextureCraft MaterialCraft SoundCraft WordCraft DeckCraft CADCraft GridCraft
Container.Requires: x86-64 host. Use a trusted local network or strong external authentication.
